law: REFERENCE-AUTHORITY.md citation law and PASS1.md: living/editor documents govern current semantics; dated snapshots are historical unless explicitly pinned for reproducibility. Every file this table ingests is a REPRODUCIBILITY PIN of an authority at a recorded commit (git ls-remote head at ingest time), never the current authority itself. The register (REGISTER.json) carries the commit, blob id, sha256 and observation time of every copy.

retrieval.problem: the session egress policy denies every published authority host (CONNECT 403): doc.rust-lang.org, webassembly.github.io, gpuweb.github.io, w3c.github.io, html.spec.whatwg.org and the other *.spec.whatwg.org hosts, tc39.es, git-scm.com, www.w3.org, source.chromium.org, chromium.googlesource.com, raw.githack.com; D11-D13 could read sources pinned by commit only
retrieval.solution: every denied published rendering that a publisher serves through GitHub Pages is the byte-exact content of that repository's gh-pages branch; that branch is reachable with exact commit identity through the session git proxy (git ls-remote / blobless partial fetch) and its files are fetchable immutably by commit from raw.githubusercontent.com, which the policy allows. Specification sources are taken from the publisher's default branch the same way. A published host without a Pages branch (WHATWG standards, doc.rust-lang.org, git-scm.com, www.w3.org/TR snapshots, Chromium code search) has NO_ROUTE for its rendering and is ingested as source only.
allowed_route_hosts: github.com git smart-HTTP (through the session git proxy: ls-remote, partial fetch)
retrieval.not_claimed: a file taken from a gh-pages branch was NOT observed at the published host; the register marks it PAGES_BRANCH and the published URL stays NOT_OBSERVED_AT_HOST until the policy admits the host

whatwg/html.published_route: NO_ROUTE (WHATWG deploys its own build; no Pages branch)

rust-lang/reference.published_route: NO_ROUTE (mdBook build deployed by rust-lang CI)

rust-lang/cargo.published_route: NO_ROUTE (the cargo gh-pages branch is a stub, not the book)

chromium/chromium.published_route: NO_ROUTE (GitHub mirror of the source is the copy)

google/swiftshader.published_host: https://github.com/google/swiftshader (denied for HTTPS page access; git and raw allowed)
